summary: The twelve cranial nerves now render as TRAVELING TRACTS in both surfaces, through the existing TractTube machinery, with route (a) (procedural) for the 2D live section — 0 bytes of new payload. WHAT CHANGED (7 files, all inside the exclusive write scope): (1) src/geometry/curves.ts — added NERVE_COURSES: the twelve NerveCourseRecords (a superset of TractRecord: region, kind:'nerve', foramen, anchorId/anchorNote, calibreMm, clinical, refs), PLUS NERVE_COURSE_IDS, nerveCourseById, hasNerveCourse. Chains are PLAN.md §3.3 verbatim: root nucleus origin3d -> cisternal segment -> the exit landmark as a LITERAL waypoint -> named foramen -> target; 84 waypoints, exit-landmark deviation 0.000 au (tolerance 2.0), min CLIP_BOUNDS clearance 6.00 au, radius converted at 1 au = 1.2 mm from the stated mm calibre (III 3.0mm->1.25au ... IV 1.0mm->0.42au ... V 4.5mm->1.88au); the table lives here because PLAN.md §3.2 puts it in src/data/structures/nerve-courses.json + src/types.ts + src/data/load.ts, which are OTHER tasks' files (data-core/course-author) and were not in my scope — the header documents the migration point and .dsh-swarm/_regen-curves.mjs is the build recipe. (2) src/components/viewer3d/TractTube.tsx — exported the existing sweep: buildTractGeometry + tubeGeometryFor (no behaviour change; only the export). (3) SceneLayers.tsx — isTractVisible now passes the record's OWN registry kind (const kind = entry?.kind ?? 'tract') instead of the literal 'tract', fixing the toggle defect at the line that held it (23-tract behaviour byte-identical); added exported nerveCoursesVisible(courses, layers) and the visibleNerveCourses pass that mounts one <TractTube> per course; the structure pass returns null for hasNerveCourse(record.id), retiring the schematic ellipsoid (one record, one body) while keeping the record, its origin3d/size3d, its function/clinical and the honesty statement in anchorNote. (4) src/components/section/sectionAssets.ts — SECTION_NERVE_PARTS (12 meta rows: slug=group=course id, region from the course, taxonomyKind 'nerve', so isPartVisible gates them), partsForCanvas() = SECTION_PARTS (unchanged, still 138) + SECTION_NERVE_PARTS, and registryNerveParts() = the 12 tubes through the EXISTING registryPartFromGeometry(meta, tubeGeometryFor(course)) adapter, so the 3D tube and the 2D contour are the same geometry by construction. (5) SectionCanvas.tsx — the two call sites now read partsForCanvas() (visible list) and append registryNerveParts() to the worker registry message; PipSection mounts <SectionCanvas /> with no props, so the PiP inherits it. (6) scripts/verify/cranial-nerve-render.mjs — the new gate, 47 assertions. NOTE the view-filter-consistency 4-state sweep CAUGHT a real defect in my first cut (suppressing the blob inside isStructureVisible made that predicate stop answering the layer question) and the fix moved the suppression into the render, documented in place. ENVIRONMENT-ONLY, not product: verify:anatomy and verify:imaging-fit still fail on the documented sandbox boundary (spawnSync powershell/node.exe EPERM); Chrome lanes (verify:audit, verify:acceptance) cannot run here. ORCHESTRATOR MUST CONFIRM IN THE BROWSER: that the 3D scene PAINTS the twelve tubes and the Systems row's 'Cranial nerves' button shows/hides exactly them, that the live section and the PiP PAINT the nerve contours, and that click-select works on both surfaces. DEVIATIONS FROM PLAN: (a) courses live in src/geometry/curves.ts, not src/data/structures/nerve-courses.json (scope — migration point documented in the file and above); (b) the shared tube builder stays in TractTube.tsx instead of a new src/geometry/tubeGeometry.ts (that path was not in the write scope), so sectionAssets imports it from there — the geometry is still shared, and the module is already in the main bundle; (c) the 12 course records keep their clinical items and refs, so they remain full TractRecord supersets. npm script line requested from the integrator: "verify:cranial-nerve-render": "node scripts/verify/cranial-nerve-render.mjs".
